mapper.sql: a.id, a.slug, a.title, a.subtitle, a.body_md, a.cover_media_id, a.language, a.status, a.published_at, a.author_id, coalesce(nullif(u.nick_name, ''), u.user_name) as author_name, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.update_by, a.update_time
mapper.select: select id from nad_article where slug = #{slug}

select , (select count(*) from nad_article_comment c where c.article_id = a.id and c.status = 'VISIBLE') as comment_count from nad_article a left join sys_user u on u.user_id = a.author_id
and a.status = #{status} and a.language = #{language}
and (a.title like concat('%', #{q}, '%') or a.subtitle like concat('%', #{q}, '%'))
order by coalesce(a.published_at, a.create_time) desc, a.id desc
mapper.insert: insert into nad_article (slug, title, subtitle, body_md, language, status, author_id, create_by, create_time, update_time) values (#{slug}, #{title}, #{subtitle}, #{bodyMd}, #{language}, #{status}, #{authorId}, #{createBy}, now(), now())
mapper.update: update nad_article set slug = #{slug}, title = #{title}, subtitle = #{subtitle}, body_md = #{bodyMd}, language = #{language}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}

update nad_article set status = #{status}, published_at = case when #{status} = 'PUBLISHED' then coalesce(published_at, now()) else published_at end, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
update nad_article set cover_media_id = #{mediaId}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into nad_article_image (article_id, media_id, sort_order, create_by, create_time) values (#{articleId}, #{mediaId}, #{sortOrder}, #{createBy}, now())
mapper.select: select count(*) from nad_article_image where article_id = #{articleId}
